key_difference: (D) has the same core design: a new QThreadStorageData::clear() that skips the thread when it has no QThreadData, inline clearLocalData() in both the thread and no-thread variants, and a value-based QThreadStorage in the collator. It differs from (B) in that it keeps composition with a forwarding localData() instead of privately inheriting QThreadStorage<GenerationalCollator>, adds a redundant tls-slot pre-check in clear(), and does not document clearLocalData() as the one call that is safe during shutdown.
